bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical evaluation and literature review demonstrating how universal evaluation metrics fail to account for cross-cultural variations in values, preferences, and definitions of model quality.
Conceptual critique of how aggregate performance metrics used in AI scaling laws obscure systemic under-performance and value friction for marginalized subpopulations.

Theoretical analysis of sampling distributions in large-scale datasets, highlighting how web-crawled data disproportionately represents specific demographic, geographic, and socio-economic groups while excluding others.
